Q24.manaTiming: existing local accept/windup/commit scheme; n214–217 explicit castpt.56; at effect recheck, pay30/startCD2, one AnySkillStart then apply; interrupted pre-effect no payment; event kills source cancels payload without refund
Q24.target: self or visible friendly ground/air organic nonstructure/nonmechanical, incl invulnerable (explicit custom mask), no hidden/Aloc/magicimmune; ethereal allowed; no N535 friendlyblock
Q24.effect: attackR additive .2/.3/.4/.5; DataB absent=>0 movement bonus local default. DataC.2=>visual scale factor1.2 with no collision/range/HP change
Q24.stack: one Bblo slot for this local family; latest replaces amount+expiry even weaker; visual scale from base not multiplied repeatedly; different buff family bonuses remain distinct. Ordinary positive dispel, explicitremove,newmagicimmune,death/removal/expiry clears; source death does not remove committed buff
Q24.autoInitial: auto=Ablo maps to unique attached Ablo-code skill, defaulton (explicit local alias mapping); independent bloodluston/off, not B012. No nonexistent skill created by auto string
Q24.autoTarget: scan every.25 battle seconds from activation, only ready/source not in cast or attack windup/manual move or incompatible command. Consider eligible friends currently in a valid ordinary attack order, lacking Bblo; choose nearest other friendly, B04tie; self fallback only when no such other and self attacking. Do not prebuff idle units or passive-only immolation towers
Q24.autoRaces: scan enqueues normal target order; original alreadyqueued same-time events precede scan; coalesce identical pending order; commit handles cost/CD competition
Q24.resources: source unit mana0=400 but manaN=200/250/300/350; anyBuildCompleteHandler explicitly resets current to max, so casting uses live current max, not400 borrowed mana
Q24.rng: none; no native SPELL_EFFECT for auto toggle itself

poison.auxiliaryVariant: N094100DPS no workbook/no initialcarrier/no explicit script acquisition; not inserted into upgrade chain

Q24.entry: nonillusion enabled source successful ordinary weapon primary hit; not ATTACKED/windup or arbitrary attack=true script packet; enemy organic ground/air nonstructure/nonmechanical, no Aloc/hidden/invul/ethereal; magicimmune allowed
Q24.apply: after hit qualification before ordinary packet; one per logical caster,target pair across N093–95, refresh5sec and update DPS, preserve tick phase. Target killed by ordinary event clears poison
Q24.tick: first at initial application+1s then1s, inclusive expiry endpoint; source-specific tracks tick separately B05/B04 and each runs B03. Same source refresh not extra stack; different logical caster tracks stack including same unit type (explicit interpretation of ambiguous official differing-unit examples); source removal cancels, death with live handle continues
Q24.packet: source S,false,false,NORMAL/NORMAL physical raw DPS; after native reduction before map callback cap to min(max(0,reduced),max(0,currentLife-2)). Zero capped amount no new event; map damage changes/extra packets may kill, no final floor or reverse healing
Q24.slow: all active poison tracks attackR decrease max(.2) once, not sum because DataD lacks attack-rate bit; DataC absent explicitly no movement slow; do not misread Poi2 as movement
Q24.remove: ordinary magic/negative dispel no effect (physical poison); explicit remove Bpoi clears all local poison tracks+Bpsd; explicit Bpsd removes slow presentation/effect until next poison refresh, does not erase DOT; target death/removal/ineligible clears; newmagicimmune alone does not clear
Q24.costRng: no mana/CD/SPELL_EFFECT/N535; one strongest poison ability per same caster hit if artificially coexist; no new RNG

Q24.marker: N105–107 reuse AOcr no-extra-native-contribution rule; actual armor effect follows attached T041–43, not an additional marker duplicate. Removing marker does not remove separately attached native ability
Q24.entry: successful nonillusion enabled ordinary weapon hit; legal enemy ground/air/ward incl structures/mechanical, no Aloc/hidden/invul/ethereal, magicimmune allowed. Native attack legality remains weapon-specific
Q24.timing: apply armor reduction before current hit native armor reduction, so triggering attack benefits; full normal B03 follows, no additional damage event. Explicit local ordering, not inferred from tooltip
Q24.stack: one BIcb slot among T041–43; latest replaces penalty and5sec expiry, mayweaken, not stack multiple hits/casters; other independent armor modifiers sum as usual. No new RNG/CD/mana
Q24.remove: magic/negative dispel cannot remove; explicit BIcb remove/death/removal/expiry clears; source death/removal does not cancel already applied debuff; magicimmune retains
Q24.missingBonus: custom DataA absent=>local0 extra fixed attack; not add stock5. Original ordinary amount preserved. Metadata Iob5=2 enables weapon slot2 but does not supply absent attack profile
Q24.attack2: record enabledslot2; source n240–242 weapon2 lacks range/damage/dice/target mask. Local no generated secondary weapon: an incomplete slot is unusable; do not clone slot1 or silently grant air attack. If a later independently audited transformation supplies valid slot2, ordinary weapon selector can use it
Q24.crossOrb: this batch innate carriers have no second audited attack orb; future artificial multi-orb coexistence requires original acquisition/ability rules, not assumed globally exclusive or stacking

Q24.entry: enabled alive actual source continuous passive; no toggle/bluecost/cooldown/ATTACKED/SPELL_EFFECT/RNG. Suppressed while hidden/illusion/hex or underconstruction, normal silence/stun/pause do not by themselves disable passive
Q24.schedule: activation records firsttick=activation+1s then every1s; per source clock, no extra instanttick on enemyentry. State/rank changes keep phase while same logical source persists, disabled/dead/removal cancels and a future fresh activation starts new phase. Upgrade continues old ability until transaction replaces ability; replacement rank uses current tick values without extra immediate tick
Q24.targets: at each tick actual source current position, closed600 B04 snapshot, enemy ground/air/structure/mechanical from custom enemies mask; no hidden/Aloc/invul/magicimmune. Ordinary invisibility may be hit; ethereal permitted by spell damage and existing B03 modifier
Q24.damage: one actual source false,false,NORMAL/MAGIC per target; complete B03, normal lethal allowed (not poison/disease2HP). If source removed/killed within nested event stop remaining current recipients; target state rechecked per packet
Q24.stack: each source emits independent packets; no shared Bpig max rule; multiple abilities on same logical source choose largest magnitude once. No lingering DOT on targets after leavingcircle, source unavailable or current tick; Bpig only emitter/display state not transferable enemyinfection
Q24.weapon: n021–25 weaponsOn missing, unit actual tooltip明确无攻击力; Q24 disabled ordinary weapon attacks (no slot activation invented from dormant dmgplus/dice), so passive alone cannot create ATTACKED or trigger Bloodlust combat autocast
